pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-to-large irregular tan patches with smooth, rounded edge gradients and non-angular vertices. Patch size is larger on the neck and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more densely packed regions on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Wide, continuous off-white interstitial pathways forming a consistent topological graph. Junction nodes are clearly defined with relatively uniform pixel thickness between patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the upper neck mane, characterized by short, uniform hair-like projections.
